raw_set_invariant.statement: During frozen eliminate_var_capped on a unit-free ordinary state, the raw accumulator contains retained clauses plus distinct non-tautological resolvents only. The implementation initializes seen with retained clauses and charges a resolvent only if it is not already in seen.
raw_set_invariant.consequence: After eliminating pivot x from an n-live-variable state, every charged raw clause is a distinct consistent nonempty signed clause over at most n-1 remaining variables.

raw_universe_theorem.name: UNIQUE_RAW_CLAUSE_UNIVERSE_CEILING
raw_universe_theorem.statement: For every ordinary pivot in a unit-free state with n>=2 live variables, RAW_x <= Uraw(n)=3^(n-2)*(2n+1).
proof: For m=n-1 remaining variables, rank-k consistent nonempty clauses number C(m,k)*2^k.
A rank-k clause contributes k+1 state units (one clause unit plus k literal units).
Because raw clauses are unique and consistent, the accumulator is bounded by the total cost of the entire nonempty signed-clause universe on m variables.

combined_pivot_bound.statement: At a unit-free ordinary state of size s with n live variables, every pivot satisfies RAW_x <= min(T(s),Uraw(n)), where T(s)=max(s,1+(s-1)^2/12).

combined_reachable_recurrence.step_safety: If min(T(s),Uraw(n))<=N^2, every live pivot is cap-safe.
combined_reachable_recurrence.next_state_bound: After exact elimination and any unit propagation, n'<=n-1 and state_units<=min(T(s),Smax(n-1)); Smax is the signed-LYM canonical ceiling.
combined_reachable_recurrence.terminal_floor: At n<=2, exact 2-SAT is checked before ordinary elimination/rescue.

range_result.through_N22: Inherited from signed-LYM combined envelope theorem.

range_result.N24: All allowed root-variable cases remain cap-certified under the combined T/Smax/Uraw recurrence.
range_result.conclusion: For every legitimate root with N<=24, v2/v3 cannot be required because ordinary exact elimination lacks raw-cap availability.
